name: Rover (Havoc)

tierList.prydwen: T3 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: Free 5-star Havoc Sword DPS unlocked after Act I Chapter 6. Builds Umbra to enter Dark Surge (enhanced Basics, +20% Havoc DMG Bonus, +25% CRIT Rate, refreshed Skill). Extremely cheap Ultimate (125 Energy, 16s CD) and access to the Dreamless 4-cost Echo (highest-damaging Echo skill in the game, +50% within 5s of Ultimate).

skills.resonanceSkill: Wingblade - Havoc hit; becomes Lifetaker (enhanced) in Dark Surge.
skills.forte: Umbra Eclipse - governs Umbra (max 100) -> Devastation (Heavy Attack, enters Dark Surge, -10% enemy Havoc RES for 20s) -> enhanced Basic/Heavy chain.
skills.liberation: Deadening Abyss - big single-target Havoc nuke, 1520% multiplier at level 10, unusually cheap Energy cost.
skills.intro: Instant of Annihilation - Havoc strike, restores Umbra (also refills Dark Surge if cast during it).
skills.outro: Soundweaver - Havoc field, 143.3% ATK per tick every 2s for 6s.

bestWeapons: Emerald of Genesis (100%, best permanent, near-equal to sigs)
Somnoire Anchor (91.24%, best free 4-star for extended field time)
Lunar Cutter (best for short field time)
echoSet: Havoc Eclipse (best - 10% Havoc DMG + up to 30% ramping, with the Dreamless main echo for burst)
substatPriority: Energy Regen (until satisfied, mostly unneeded outside Dual DPS)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Roccia is the best buffer (20% Havoc + 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplify).

teams.name: F2P Team
teams.notes: Both fully free and strong; Danjin edges out Sanhua slightly.

teams.name: Phrolova Team
teams.notes: High personal damage and Energy generation make Rover a strong Phrolova teammate alternative.

rotation: Short Burst: Intro -> Skill -> Heavy: Devastation -> Skill: Lifetaker (swap-cancel) -> Ultimate -> Echo: Dreamless (swap-cancel) -> Outro. Medium/Long Burst variants add 1-3 full Dark Surge Basic chains before the Ultimate for higher total damage at more field time.
communityNotes: Prydwen: strong, flexible free Main DPS or burst Dual DPS with a very cheap Ultimate and the game's highest-damaging Echo skill (Dreamless); main weakness is one of the longest on-field times among Main DPS and a damaging (not buffing) Outro that leaves it behind premium quickswap options like Changli/Brant.
